 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. High school football is about to kick off around the Gadsden area to start AHSAA playoff Round one action.
 Fifteen Gadsden-area teams made the playoffs, headlined by five from Etowah County. Westbrook Christian led the way for region champs joined by Boaz, Fyffe, Piedmont and Plainview. Those four will host first round games joined by two-seeds that include Etowah, Cherokee County, Collinsville and Geraldine.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The new AHSAA football championship format starts with flag football title games on Tuesday, Dec. 1. The private school games are on Dec. 2 followed by the 1A and 4A games on Thursday. Friday will see the 2A and 5A games with the 3A and 6A wrapping the new five-day event on Saturday.
